verdict.rationale: Acceleration-backend breadth (Vulkan/AMD fallback) is a fair axis for any local runtime — all 7 incumbents are judged on it; the evidence documents Metal and Hexagon only, so the axis is applicable and unevidenced. Lack of evidence for an applicable capability is 'none', not 'na' (harmonized at the 2026-09-25 bring-up — every incumbent holds a non-na verdict on this story).
